text: The chapter defines the common configuration and management aspects of the AALi as they relate to the AAL\_PUSCH\_FEC and AAL\_PDSCH\_FEC profiles. The AALi configuration and management APIs are the API's that an AAL application \(O-DU\) executes to configure and manage the AAL-LPU\(s\) that have been allocated to the application by the O-Cloud.

text_preview:
This section contains information for each supported AAL profile. 

A profile may provide specific APIs for configuration, in addition to general AAL configuration APIs. Profile-specific configuration applies on a per queue basis and only for functionality that cannot be changed at run time. Each profile defines a capabilities list used to define the operations supported by the AAL-LPU.

text: 6.1.1 Operation Representation
trace: 6 AAL Profile Specifications --> 6.1 Profile Specifications Overview --> 6.1.1 Operation Representation
text_preview: 6.1.1 Operation Representation

text: Operations offloaded to the AAL-LPU are represented by a single operation context that shall include all necessary information required by the AAL Implementation to process the operation.
trace: 6 AAL Profile Specifications --> 6.1 Profile Specifications Overview --> 6.1.1 Operation Representation
text_preview: Operations offloaded to the AAL-LPU are represented by a single operation context that shall include all necessary information required by the AAL Implementation to process the operation.

text: The operation context defines the operation type as supported by the AAL Profile. It includes an operation status, a reference to the operation specific data, which can vary in size and content depending on the operation/profile being provisioned. Application software is responsible for specifying all the operation-specific fields that are then used by the AAL-LPU to process the requested operation.
trace: 6 AAL Profile Specifications --> 6.1 Profile Specifications Overview --> 6.1.1 Operation Representation
text_preview: The operation context defines the operation type as supported by the AAL Profile, including an operation status and reference to operation-specific data. Application software specifies operation-specific fields, which are processed by the AAL-LPU.

text: Scheduling of AAL operations on an application data path is performed using a burst oriented asynchronous API set. A queue on an AAL-LPU accepts a burst of operations \(1 to N number of operations\) using enqueue API. The enqueue API will place the operations to be processed on the AAL-LPU's hardware input. The dequeue API will retrieve any processed operations available from the queue on the AAL-LPU.
